nodes.title: START HERE
widgets_values:
SIMPLE MUSIC VIDEO TEMPLATE

1. Choose models, resolution and a master song. Load the reference images for each location.
2. Use the Clip Director to select each clip's reference bank, duration, complete prompt, seed and take. New clips start with their own 7-second value. Change each duration independently; later song slices shift automatically.
3. Queue selected clips or all populated clips. Save this workflow after editing.
4. Generated MP4 clips are saved by project, clip number and take number. Import them into your video editor to assemble the final music video.

Reference banks contain images only. The Director selects a bank and sends it to H3 through one connection. Populated images become Picture 1, Picture 2, etc. in bank order: face/hair, outfit/body/shoes, then location views. Use those labels in each complete clip prompt. H3 still needs its text encoder.
